votes.quote: The bug: the function never checks whether the text actually says "major". In `src/keyScaleAgreement.ts:30-32`, anything that isn't "minor" is treated as major... The spec says the mode should be "major" only if the whole word `major` appears, and otherwise there is no mode, so the result should be `undefined`. Because of the bug: `keyScaleAgreement("C", "C", "major")` returns `true` instead of `undefined`.
